title: Commander Availability Map
description: Schema for mapping roles to move IDs and their initial checked state

_removes.description: Move IDs to discard after unioning all role moves. Useful in module availability files to remove base moves.

^[A-Za-z ]+$.description: A role name mapping to move availability

_movesFile.description: Path to the JSON file containing moves for this role

cards.description: Array of card IDs automatically assigned to this role (not granted by moves)

items.description: Card ID that corresponds to a folder name in data/cards/

level1Help.description: Role-specific Level 1 stat guidance, shown by the help icon next to the Level/Xp/HP/Armor row in cs.html

default-gear.description: Starting equipment choices for this role, consumed by the 'Starting Equipment' wizard button on the equipment card (data/cards/equipment)

type.description: 'get' items are granted automatically; 'pickOne' offers a radio choice; 'pick' offers a multi-select choice

title.description: Heading shown above this choice group in the wizard (omit for 'get')

name.description: Item name, goes in the equipment table's Name column

details.description: Damage/tags/effect text, goes in the equipment table's Details column

uses.description: Freetext use count, goes in the equipment table's Uses column (empty string if not applicable)

^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$.description: Move ID mapped to its initial checked state (true = initially checked, false = initially unchecked)

Navigator.description: Guides the ship through the Warp
